recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: Analyzed all 6 session-start test files. Found 3 gaps: (1) ac-activity-hierarchy and ac-activity-orphan had no tests — added 6 new tests to session-start-activity-timeline.test.ts covering linked commit hierarchy display and orphan commit distinction. (2) session-start-notes.test.ts used stale ac-1/ac-2 numbering — updated to ac-review-detail/ac-notes-starvation. (3) Replaced static source analysis test with behavioral ANSI color code check per project testing preferences. Added explicit trait tests for @trait-json-output ac-4 (ref prefix consistency) and @trait-semantic-exit-codes ac-5 (exit 0 with minimal data). All 72 session-start tests pass. Full suite passes (3584 passed, only known flaky ralph signal tests).

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: Rewrote formatSessionContext() for primer/full modes. Changes: (1) Added slug, description, status fields to ActiveTaskSummary, ReadyTaskSummary, BlockedTaskSummary, CompletedTaskSummary. (2) New section ordering: active → review → blocked → ready → activity → inbox → observations (full) → session metadata (full) → working tree → quick commands. (3) Primer: top 5 ready, 10 activity items, inbox stat line only. Full: all ready, 20 activity, 20 untriaged inbox, observations section, metadata. (4) @slug display with @short-ulid fallback. (5) Empty sections omitted entirely. (6) needs_work visually distinct from in_progress. (7) Notes shown inline under active/review tasks. (8) Observations loaded from meta context in full mode. (9) 37 new tests + 2 updated tests covering all 15 ACs. All 3571 tests pass (3 known flaky ralph).

recent_notes.task_title: Implement Session Start Computed JSON Fields
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: Implemented computed JSON fields for session start. Added SessionContextComputed interface with inbox_untriaged_count, inbox_deferred_count, inbox_total, task_unlocks (ref-to-count map), and recent_activity (mirrors activity_timeline). Wired into gatherSessionContext() after existing data is gathered. 11 integration tests covering all 3 ACs. All 3547 tests pass (1 known flaky ralph timeout).

recent_notes.task_title: Implement Session Start Inbox Triage Awareness
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: Implemented triage-aware inbox statistics for session start. Changes: (1) Extended InboxSummary with triaged/triage_action fields and added InboxStats interface. (2) gatherSessionContext now loads triage records and cross-references with inbox items by ULID. (3) Primer mode shows stat line only (untriaged/deferred/total). (4) Full mode shows untriaged items (up to 20) plus stat line. (5) Quick commands updated to suggest 'kspec triage inbox' instead of 'kspec inbox promote'. (6) Added inboxTriage hint string. (7) 13 behavioral tests covering all 4 ACs. All 3535 tests pass (2 known flaky ralph signal tests unrelated).

recent_notes.task_title: Fix flaky ralph session-budget-integration timeout test
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: [FIX_CYCLE: 1] Addressed MUST-FIX: Added .gitignore with 'sessions/' in temp repo's initial setup. This ensures ralph's session artifacts (sessions/<id>/session.yaml) don't make the repo dirty, preventing isWrapUpNeeded() from spawning the 2-minute wrap-up agent. All 3513 tests pass. Pushed to PR #512.

inbox_items.text: Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.
E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.
E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.
